transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

...Just tired, I guess. My body feels... completely drained. Like, even just walking from my car into the clinic today... or being at work and just trying to open the EHR... it just takes everything I have right now.
How long have you been feeling this level of tiredness?

Um... I don't know, a while. Maybe nine months? 

It's been about that long since I just... crashed. I had this time before that where I was running on a lot of energy, but after that ended... yeah. It's been nine months of just being exhausted. And feeling down... and guilty, I guess. Just... a long time.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before you started feeling tired and down?
Not really. I just... I don't really care about much right now. It's just too much effort.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?
No. I don't think so. Just... nothing really.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to be alive or hurting yourself?
No. Um... I don't think about that. Just... no, I haven't.
Are there things you used to look forward to that you no longer look forward to?
I don't know. Just... I guess I used to like playing video games after my shifts at the hospital, but... I haven't really touched them lately. It's just... whatever.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
No. Um... not really. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed feeling like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely energetic or irritable and didn't need much sleep?

Um... yeah, I guess. There were some days where I felt... just amazing. Like I was unstoppable or something. But... I don't know, if someone at work corrected my documentation or... told me to slow down, I'd just snap at them. It just felt like they were insulting me.
How long did those periods where you felt amazing and unstoppable last?
Um... I'm not really sure. I wasn't exactly keeping track of the days or anything. Just... a while, I guess. It's kind of a blur.
How long have you been feeling down and guilty?
Um... I don't know. A long time. Since I crashed after all that energy... maybe nine months? I just... I'm always tired now.
Did you have a period where you felt extremely happy or elevated, separate from the times you felt energetic?
Um... no, not really. I mean, it was all kind of the same thing. I just... I don't think they were different times.
Did you ever have a period where you felt extremely happy or elevated, but not necessarily energetic?
I... I think I just said, but... no. Like, if I felt that good, I always had the energy with it. They weren't separate.
Did you ever feel extremely happy or on top of the world for a period of time, even if it was just a few days?

I guess... yeah. Some days I felt amazing. Just... unstoppable. But... I don't know, if someone at work told me to slow down... or corrected my documentation... I would just snap at them. It felt like they were insulting me. So... yeah.
How long did these periods where you felt amazing and unstoppable usually last?
I don't really know... I didn't exactly keep track of the days. Just... a while, I guess.
Did you ever have a period where you felt extremely happy or elevated without also feeling extremely energetic?
I thought you just asked me that... but no. Like I said before, if I felt good, the energy was just... always there with it. I didn't have one without the other.
How long have you been feeling down and guilty, is it still the same nine months?
Yeah... I guess it's been about nine months. Ever since I crashed after all that energy... I've just been exhausted and... down. So, yeah. The same nine months.
Have you ever felt this down and guilty before the nine months you've been feeling this way?
No... I don't think so. Not like this, anyway. Just... just this time.
Have you ever felt this down before in your life?
I thought I just told you... no. Not before this. Just... just this one time.
Have you ever had a period of feeling down like this before in your life, prior to the last nine months?
I just... I don't know why you keep asking me the exact same thing. I already said no. Never before this.
Have you had another time in your life before the last nine months where you felt this down?
I... I'm not answering that again. I already told you. Three times.
